title: CommandProjection
description: Validates a parsed JSON projection of a commands/z-*.md file: YAML frontmatter merged with the markdown body as a string, plus an id derived from the filename (kebab-case, sans .md). Raw .md files are NOT validated by this schema directly.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this contract. Always 1 for this version of the spec.

id.description: Command identifier derived from the filename (kebab-case, sans .md). Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the command does.

argument_hint.description: Optional hint describing expected arguments for this command.

body.description: The full markdown body of the command (everything after the YAML frontmatter block).
